verified_at: 2026-11-05 (sidebar items re-read on main 5045114; home and create items as read on 884f1f7)
method: Read on main: src/, src-tauri/src/, crates/. 'backend' = logic or a command exists and is tested, but no UI path reaches it.

sidebar.home-entry.why: Sidebar Home row (Sidebar.tsx) and the nav.home binding, handled in src/palette/PaletteHost.tsx (go-home) through the keybinding dispatcher.

sidebar.repo-groups.why: Repos render as collapsible groups with nested workspace rows (Sidebar.tsx, store toggleRepo).

sidebar.repo-order.why: crates/openconductor-db/src/repos.rs lists repos by display_order, created_at and appends new ones at the end, but the app does not depend on that crate and the sidebar renders insertion order from localStorage.

sidebar.repo-hide.why: crates/openconductor-db repos::set_hidden and find_reusable_hidden (tested), but the app does not depend on that crate; no hide/unhide UI.

sidebar.repo-icon.why: crates/openconductor-db repos::set_icon (tested); not linked into the app and no icon UI.

sidebar.add-repo.why: Sidebar '+' runs the Open-project flow in App.tsx: native folder picker, inspect_project_folder, add_repository, then the row is added with the backend's default branch.

sidebar.ws-name.why: Row shows the name; user_set_workspace_name / user_set_branch_name are now modelled (src/state/types.ts) but no user rename sets them, and rows show a name where the reference shows the branch-style title.

sidebar.ws-branch.why: Rows show the branch-style title from workspaceLabel (src/components/sidebarLabel.ts, Conductor's display-name rule with tests): PR title, else the prettified branch; the raw branch is in the row tooltip.

sidebar.ws-status.why: Status dot uses our own idle/working/needs-review/archived model, not derived/manual status with in-progress default (src/state/types.ts).

sidebar.ws-diffstat.why: +/- counts render from stored placeholder numbers; not computed from git, no colour setting.

sidebar.ws-unread.why: Unread rows render semibold (data-unread, styles.css) as in the reference, but nothing sets Workspace.unread in the app and there is no mark-as-read/unread action or next-unread command; DB setter workspaces::set_unread is not linked.

sidebar.ws-pinned.why: crates/openconductor-db workspaces::set_pinned_at (tested); crate not linked into the app; no pinned group or pin action.

sidebar.sections.why: No sections UI or commands; navigation_sections only in crates/openconductor-db/migrations/0005_navigation_and_favorites.sql (unwired).

sidebar.ws-numbers.why: workspace.switchTo1..9 are handled in PaletteHost.tsx over sidebarOrder (fromAppState.ts); rows never show numbers and there is no setting to show them.

sidebar.ws-next-prev.why: workspace.next / workspace.previous handled in PaletteHost.tsx via stepWorkspace (wraps, sidebar order; tested in fromAppState.test.ts).

sidebar.search.why: Sidebar Search row opens the command palette, whose workspace search covers name, branch and repo (src/palette/search/model.ts).

sidebar.rename.why: rename_workspace_branch command (src-tauri workspace) and the automatic first-message rename call it; no user-facing rename action.

sidebar.archive.why: Archive from WorkspaceView and the palette (workspace.archive) only removes the localStorage row: no confirmation, no git-busy check, no call to WorkspaceManager::archive.

sidebar.archived-view.why: WorkspaceManager::restore exists (src-tauri/src/workspace/mod.rs); no command, no UI.

sidebar.resize-toggle.why: Left sidebar toggles from the in-sidebar button, Cmd+B and '[' (App.tsx); the sidebar is a fixed 256px column with no drag-to-resize, and there is no right-sidebar toggle.

sidebar.ws-actions.why: No row context menu or actions menu.

sidebar.empty-state.why: Muted single-line empty state matches evidence/screens/home.md.

sidebar.add-menu.why: '+' goes straight to the folder picker; no menu with the three Home actions and no recents (the detector hit is QuickOpen's recent files).

sidebar.visibility-settings.why: Width is now the 256px default but fixed; visibility persists inside the localStorage app state (sidebarVisible), not as a setting, and the width is not persisted.

home.route.why: Home is the default screen, but there is no router or '/' route (selection state in src/state/store.ts).

home.org-states.why: No organization concept; no loading or cloud redirect state.

home.layout.why: Matches evidence/screens: three label-only cards in a 1-to-3 grid sit at the reference position (y 368-495; x offset 4 px from the narrower sidebar), wordmark centered above, drag region, fade-in. Differences: card icons for GitHub (cloud vs globe) and Quick start (sparkle vs folder-plus); the wordmark is our own brand by design.

home.sidebar-toggle.why: Toggle shown only when the sidebar is hidden, with tooltip and shortcut hint (HomeScreen.tsx).

home.add-local.why: Open project card: native picker, inspect_project_folder (src-tauri/src/project.rs), add_repository; default branch comes from the backend.

home.open-project-flow.why: Folder checks and decision are real (project.rs, src/state/openProject.ts with tests): file:// remote on success and error toasts. The no-.git / no-origin cases only show an info toast; the init / create-GitHub-repo dialog is not built.

home.clone-github.why: Dialog parses GitHub URLs but performs no clone and has no destination picker or progress.

home.new-project.why: Quick start dialog with placeholder templates; no git init, no GitHub repo, no first workspace on disk.

home.duplicate-repo.why: Store silently ignores a duplicate path/remote; no already-exists message. Backend add_repository returns the existing id.

home.no-repo-guard.why: With no repository the create dialog explains that a repository is needed and offers Add repository (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx).

home.status-overview.why: Home shows no workspace list or statuses.

home.recent.why: The command palette keeps a most-recent-first list of visited workspaces (PaletteHost.tsx, in memory only); Home shows no recents.

home.recents.why: Clone dialog has no recent repositories (detector hit is CreateFromPicker's status line).

home.persist.why: UI state lives in localStorage; backend keeps a TSV repo registry; the Conductor-shaped SQLite schema in crates/openconductor-db is not used by the app.

create.entry.why: Cmd+N, the sidebar 'New workspace' row, each repo's '+' and the palette action all open the create dialog (App.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, PaletteHost.tsx).

create.page.why: Create is a modal form (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx) with a prompt box, repo and branch selects and a name field. The reference is a composer: repo chip, prompt, model/effort picker and Create button (REA compare at t=24: 7.6% dark, 89% light differ).

create.from-ref.why: Create-from picker with PR, branch and issue tabs (CreateFromPicker.tsx, createFrom.ts); branches come from list_branches, but PRs and issues report unavailable in the desktop app (no GitHub/Linear listing command).

create.base-branch.why: Base-branch select fed by list_branches, defaulting to the repo default branch; passed to create_workspace.

create.branch-picker.why: Branch tab in the create-from picker with search, loading, empty and error states over list_branches (CreateFromPicker.tsx, createFrom.ts statusLine).

create.worktree.why: The dialog calls create_workspace, which runs git worktree add on its own branch under the data dir (src-tauri/src/workspace/mod.rs).

create.branch-prefix.why: resolveBranchPrefix is applied in the dialog, but App.tsx passes empty prefix settings and no GitHub username, so the prefix is always none; no settings UI.

create.placeholder-name.why: City-name placeholder with rarity badge (naming.ts) in the dialog; after the first message renameAfterFirstMessage renames workspace and branch via rename_workspace_branch.

create.validation.why: buildCreateRequest validates name, repo, base branch and source and shows field errors; create_workspace rejects invalid branch names (git.rs).

create.copy-files.why: create_workspace copies .worktreeinclude / globs / .env* files (files_to_copy.rs), now reached from the dialog.

create.setup-script.why: The dialog reports no setup script; create_workspace never runs one. WorkspaceManager::run_setup and crates/scripts setup lifecycle exist but are not called (crates/scripts is not an app dependency).

create.initializing.why: The dialog shows createFlow progress (creating, failed) while create_workspace runs; there is no initializing workspace row or view, and setup steps are skipped.

create.failure.why: Failure text is shown in the dialog; no setup log, and no startup cleanup of incomplete workspaces (workspaces::delete_if_initializing exists only in the unlinked DB crate).

create.first-message.why: The first message seeds the workspace transcript and drives the rename (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx, firstMessage.ts); no agent session is started.

create.autostart-run.why: crates/scripts runner::should_auto_run (tested) decides auto-run after setup, but setup never runs on create and the crate is not an app dependency.

sidebar.top-bar.why: Sidebar header (Sidebar.tsx) has the toggle button (view.toggleLeftSidebar) and back/forward arrows wired to useNavHistory (src/state/useNavHistory.ts, history.ts with tests), disabled at either end; REA capture on 5045114 places all three where the reference does.

sidebar.computer-switcher.why: Computer row with initial avatar, name and chevron is rendered (Sidebar.tsx), but App.tsx never passes a computer name so it always reads 'My Mac' (reference: "<user>'s Mac"), and the row opens no menu.

sidebar.primary-nav.why: Home, Create and Search rows with shortcut hints (Sidebar.tsx NavRow): Home selects home, Create opens the create dialog, Search opens the command palette.

sidebar.workspaces-group.why: Sentence-case 'My workspaces' section header with hover chevron and '...' menu (Add project…) replaces the uppercase Repositories header (Sidebar.tsx).

sidebar.footer-actions.why: Footer with help menu (HelpMenu.tsx, helpMenuItems.ts with tests) and settings icon buttons (Sidebar.tsx), matching the reference position in the REA capture.

sidebar.colors.why: Conductor --sidebar-* tokens, 256px width, 60% fill and border (styles.css). REA compare-web-screenshots on 5045114 captures, threshold 24, sidebar region x<256: 0.90% dark / 0.88% light (populated), 0.62% collapsed, 0.61%/0.59% empty Home.

home.colors.why: Measured: dark main #17191d vs #141110, dark card #24272d vs #211e1c; light main #f7f7f5 vs #ffffff, light card #efefec vs #fafaf9. Every pixel differs at threshold 0 (REA compare-web-screenshots).
